text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day on the way home, as I passed 
through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's kind of noisy...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In my hand is a single raffle ticket from 
my shopping earlier. This is—
choice_data_list: You've got no choice but to pull, Taishin!
You've got no choice but to pull, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you draw it by yourself? I'm 
heading home ahead of you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, these things are usually rigged 
so you don't win anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize is nothing but a distant 
dream—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Aiming for the grand prize, little 
lady? Nice! You gotta dream big, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No, I'm...!
choice_data_list: We're aiming for the grand prize, Taishin!
We're aiming for the grand prize, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh! Shut up, dummy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin cranked the lottery wheel 
in near desperation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I actually won... a hot springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she was so utterly flabbergasted 
that Narita Taishin actually became 
somewhat docile—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it was your lottery ticket to 
begin with. Doesn't that make the travel 
voucher yours too?”
choice_data_list:
Since Taishin won it for you, go and enjoy 
yourself

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …………Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so you want one of us to 
accompany you on a trip."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, sweet! If it's a hot spring, then 
I—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hold on, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Fugoh!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You should also be more perceptive to 
the subtle nuances of your friends once in 
a while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Taishin. We're going to be busy for 
a while, so we won't be able to make it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You'll have a mountain of things to do 
even after the Twinkle Series, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there are probably others better 
suited for it than us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Best person for the job? ...W-Who are you 
talking about?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which would be more 
embarrassing: leaving it unsaid, or having 
me spell it all out?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I hate that about you, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so? I actually find your 
clumsiness quite charming.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, as soon as Narita Taishin walked 
into the Trainer's office, she marched 
straight up to me and practically thrust 
hot spring trip tickets into my hands.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: On hold.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...If you haven't found anyone in 
particular by the time the deadline 
comes—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Anyway!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: On hold for now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up holding onto the hot 
springs voucher—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's huge...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Even the biggest Umamusume food 
lovers will be totally satisfied with a 
hearty portion like this!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm telling you, that's way too much for 
me...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, while I was working in the 
trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are. ...Did you eat dinner 
already?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. ...You're not gonna tell me you 
dislike bolognese, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you break up pre-packaged burger 
patties, they can double as ground meat.
choice_data_list:
You made it out of that carrot hamburg 
steak?!

You made it out of that carrot hamburg 
steak?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but is there a problem with 
that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...It was your raffle ticket in the first 
place, so you've got every right to eat it 
too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So... look, it's gonna get cold, so hurry 
up. Get ready to eat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...Sharing a hamburger steak in half is 
totally out of the question, but with 
this—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us thoroughly enjoyed Narita 
Taishin's special homemade bolognese.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that really is a huge heap... Or 
rather, isn't this way too piled up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, whatever. If that's how it's gonna 
be—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa!! It really is a massive mountain 
of carrots--!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It certainly was a tall order for just the 
two of you to clear that amount of food.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Are you sure I can take as much 
as I want?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Sure, but... Don't blame me if you 
overeat."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!! We're having a carrot party when 
we get home!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You weren't listening at all, were you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. ...Then, I suppose I shall 
gratefully accept as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering what to put in 
Brian's bento. You really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna thank someone, tell that 
Trainer over there, okay? The raffle 
tickets were theirs anyway.
choice_data_list:
Taishin was the one who suggested sharing, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOOOOU!! I knew you were nice deep 
down, Taishiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Agh, give me a break! You're so annoying! 
It's not like I'm being nice or anything!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'll kick you, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, a fun carrot party was held.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That's what they say. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin threw a carrot right at me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You won the prize with your own raffle 
ticket, so it belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's almost dinner time, so let's 
hurry up and go ho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrruuummmble~~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Quiet.
choice_data_list: Want me to give you a carrot?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up! I'm not hungry, and I 
don't want any...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrruuummmble~~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uuuuggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, when I offered the carrot to 
her once more, Narita Taishin accepted it 
in silence.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Tissues.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just forced to draw in someone 
else's place, so I don't care what prize 
it is anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...You can go to a hot spring without 
having to win a lottery, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Being comforted weirdly like that just 
makes me feel awkward, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, let's go home. You can keep 
the pocket tissues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Narita Taishin walked off with quick 
strides, her profile betrayed a hint of 
lingering frustration.
